Motomation Design · templates

Page templates

8 whole reference pages composed from the library's sections, plus 2 scroll-as-film pages. Each one passed the Delivery Gate and carries its stamp in the source.

Page templates (8)

  • The river took the school · The Delta Review

    editorial article · tier 2 · broadsheet

    A long-read set like a broadsheet: masthead, deck and columns, one pull quote that inks in as it is read, and a folio footer that remembers what you've read.

  • Monsoon Jazz Night · National Theatre Hall, 14 November

    event landing · tier 4 · poster

    A one-night concert as a poster: the name under stage light, the lineup in running order, tickets drawn as tickets, and how to get to the hall.

  • Haveli Panam · seven rooms in Sonargaon

    hotel / hospitality · tier 2 · room

    A heritage hotel that opens with a door: the courtyard, the upstairs gallery of rooms, rates by season, one guest-book entry, and the way from Dhaka.

  • River Commons · a public trust for Bangladesh's rivers

    public-interest organisation · tier 2 · manifesto

    A river trust's case in one page: the claim, a year of audited hearings, the people who watch the banks, gifts tied to real costs, and its registration.

  • Letters from Nusrat · one letter a month

    personal brand · tier 2 · letter

    A writer's homepage that is this month's letter: written to the reader, with replies that came in the post and a postscript to subscribe.

  • Tally · bookkeeping in Bangla and English for small shops

    SaaS landing · tier 2 · workbench

    A bookkeeping app for corner shops where the product is the page: the day's ledger, the four screens, the export line, one customer's evening, two plans.

  • Mati · No. 14-07, Ash celadon plate

    e-commerce product · tier 2 · catalogue

    One plate from a small firing, sold like a catalogue lot: the object, its making in four steps, buyers' notes, a hold to reserve, then the rest of the shelf.

  • Hawa Studio · design for public institutions, Dhaka

    portfolio (studio) · tier 2 · ledger

    A design studio's site kept as its account book: projects as ledger entries, services with fixed shapes, the team at the table, and the wait for a new start.

Tier 5 films (2)

  • Noor Haque · titles and motion for film

    tier 5 · film-reel · 180 frames
